title: Core Awakening
tagline: Dismantle rogue Titans, salvage subsystems, and rebuild your core.
pitch: Awaken as a surviving Titan core inside a modular salvage mech. Read telegraphed enemy attacks, target specific subsystems to preserve precious salvage, and instantly decide whether to install, secure, or dismantle recovered components.
coreLoop: Evade telegraphed enemy attacks while aiming at specific subsystems. Defeat enemies to claim intact components, then decide to Install, Secure, or Dismantle them before choosing to Extract or press deeper.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Aim cursor directly at glowing enemy parts (Weapon Arm vs Main Core). Destroying the core first leaves the weapon intact for high-tier salvage.

mechanics.name: Telegraphed Evasion
mechanics.description: Dash through red-orange threat sectors right before attacks execute to trigger invulnerability and counter-attack bonuses.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Salvage Decision
mechanics.description: Picking up components opens an immediate choice overlay: INSTALL (new firepower/stat boost), SECURE (high score bonus), or DISMANTLE (instant hull repair).

controls.keyboard: WASD or Arrow Keys to move mech, Space/Shift to Dash, 1/2/3 keys for quick salvage choice
controls.mouse: Aim reticle, Left Click to fire primary weapon / select targets, Right Click to dash
controls.touch: Virtual joystick on left, tap right to fire, swipe to dash, tap UI buttons for salvage choices

artDirection.backgroundFx: Pulsing energy conduits, floor grid shimmers, ambient glowing spark particles in dark industrial titan vault

audioDirection.musicMood: Dark pulsing industrial synth with heavy bass impact

difficulty.start: Single automaton Titan with readable 1.5s telegraphed arc slash attacks.
difficulty.progression: Enemies attack faster, cycle attack patterns, and add hazard zones upon subsystem failure.
difficulty.peak: Relentless aggressor Titans with overlapping laser sector telegraphs and rapid shield regenerations.

winLose.win: Defeat the room threat, salvage key components, and safely choose EXTRACT with high salvage score.
winLose.lose: Core Integrity drops to 0% due to unmitigated enemy damage.

juice.screenShake: Heavy screen shake on subsystem breakdown and enemy core explosion
juice.particles: Cyan energy trail on player dash, directional orange spark bursts on kinetic impacts
juice.hitStop: 100ms freeze-frame when destroying an enemy subsystem
juice.flash: Red telegraph warning flashes before attacks; cyan flash across player mech upon installing component

scopeNotes: Excluded procedural dungeons, persistent meta-upgrades shop, complex inventory screens, and story cutscenes. Single single-screen isometric arena with dynamic component drop flow.
